run_parallel_execution_threads: run a function in parallel across multiple threads using ThreadPool with configurable worker count
run_parallel_execution_processes: run a function in parallel across multiple processes using Pool for compute-intensive tasks
run_parallel_execution_sequential: run a function sequentially with progress bar tracking instead of parallel execution
run_parallel_execution_async: run a function asynchronously and return a pool object for deferred result collection
run_parallel_execution_callback: run a function in parallel with a custom callback to transform each result before collecting
